نحج (form I)
# نَحُجُّ (naḥujju) /na.ħud͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# نُحَجُّ (nuḥajju) /nu.ħad͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# نَحُجَّ (naḥujja) /na.ħud͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# نُحَجَّ (nuḥajja) /nu.ħad͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past passive
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
